scope: Actual Codex in-app browser on localhost:5173, production build, real microphone permission granted by user; not physical latency/long-run acceptance
causes: Browser mode auto-started before a user gesture; AudioContext.resume could stay pending.
App retry returned while initInFlight was true.
getUserMedia could remain pending indefinitely waiting for microphone permission.
fixes: Browser now starts via START AUDIO, calling resume synchronously before asynchronous preparation. Native auto-start remains unchanged.
Resume is bounded to 15 seconds; capture permission is bounded to 20 seconds. UI reports the thrown error and exits the connecting state.
Capture streams granted after timeout are stopped rather than leaked.

validation.selectedPlaybackOutput: Realtek speakers; changed from default VoiceMeeter Aux output in the test UI
validation.outputTestTone: Triggered on selected Realtek output without a new reported error
validation.physicalAudibility: Not independently measured; user can listen during testing

finalUi.track1: Stopped with test loop retained for replay

privacy: No captured microphone PCM or WAV is stored in the repository; only UI screenshots and text diagnostics are committed.
